source_text:
[L1] Residential Lease Agreement
[L2] The Tenant must pay NGN 1,200,000 annually on 1 January.
[L3] The Landlord may terminate this Agreement immediately for any breach.
[L4] The Landlord or its agents may enter the premises at any time without prior notice.
[L5] This Agreement renews automatically unless the Tenant gives 90 days written notice.

analysis.title: Residential Lease Agreement
analysis.executive_summary: The lease contains one-sided termination, entry, and renewal provisions that deserve attention.

key_terms.quote: The Tenant must pay NGN 1,200,000 annually on 1 January.

risk_assessment.title: Immediate termination
risk_assessment.explanation: Minor breaches could trigger termination without time to cure.
risk_assessment.recommendation: Request written notice and a cure period.
risk_assessment.quote: The Landlord may terminate this Agreement immediately for any breach.

risk_assessment.title: Entry without notice
risk_assessment.clause: Entry at any time without prior notice
risk_assessment.explanation: The provision gives broad access rights.
risk_assessment.recommendation: Request reasonable prior notice except in emergencies.
risk_assessment.quote: The Landlord or its agents may enter the premises at any time without prior notice.

risk_assessment.title: Automatic renewal
risk_assessment.explanation: The tenant could miss a long cancellation window.
risk_assessment.recommendation: Request a renewal reminder and shorter notice period.
risk_assessment.quote: This Agreement renews automatically unless the Tenant gives 90 days written notice.

obligations.quote: The Tenant must pay NGN 1,200,000 annually on 1 January.
